description:
Prepare the box to back up OFF THE SERVER into S3-compatible object storage
    (default target: Cloudflare R2). Run this ONCE per box, BEFORE `backup_setup(s3_bucket=...)`.

    Three steps: (1) install an rclone new enough for S3/R2 - the distro build (1.60.1 on
    Ubuntu 24.04) mishandles R2, so we install the upstream .deb and REFUSE anything older
    than 1.75.0; (2) write the remote into /root/.config/rclone/rclone.conf at 0600, keeping any
    other remote already there, with `no_check_bucket = true` (without it rclone tries to
    CREATE the bucket and a bucket-scoped token gets a 403 that looks like a read-only key);
    (3) probe WRITE and READ **separately** - they are separate permissions and we have met a
    token where one worked and the other did not - by uploading a nonce and reading it back.

    CREDENTIALS ARE NEVER TOOL ARGUMENTS. Put them in your `secrets.json` (chmod 600):
        "s3_access_key_id", "s3_secret_access_key", and for R2 "s3_account_id"
        (or "s3_endpoint" for another provider). ZX_S3_* env vars work too.
    Nothing this tool returns ever contains the key.

    `provider`: r2 (default) | aws | minio | wasabi | scaleway | other.
    dry_run shows every step with the credentials redacted; confirm executes.
name: offsite_s3_setup
